policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="rpcMethod" value="@{
      if (context.Request.Method != "POST") { return ""; }
      var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
      if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) { return ""; }
      var m = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(body)["method"];
      return m == null ? "" : m.ToString();
    }" />
    <set-variable name="rpcId" value="@{
      if (context.Request.Method != "POST") { return "null"; }
      var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
      if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) { return "null"; }
      var id = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(body)["id"];
      return id == null ? "null" : id.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
    }" />
    
      
        
      
    
    
    
    @((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])

choose.when:
<set-variable name="respBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        <set-variable name="rowCount" value="@{
          try {
            var body = (string)context.Variables["respBody"];
            var json = body.Trim();
            if (!json.StartsWith("{")) {
              var idx = json.LastIndexOf("data:");
              if (idx < 0) { return 0; }
              json = json.Substring(idx + 5).Trim();
            }
            var msg = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(json);
            var text = (string)msg["result"]["content"][0]["text"];
            var rows = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(text)["rows"] as Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray;
            return rows == null ? 0 : rows.Count;
          } catch { return 0; }
        }" />
        
        
          
            
              
              application/json
              @((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])
              @((string)context.Variables["blockReason"] == "rows" ? "row-limit " + context.Variables["rowCount"] + ">__MAXROWS__" : "response-size")
              @("{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + (string)context.Variables["rpcId"] + ",\"result\":{\"isError\":true,\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"Blocked by gateway policy: the result has " + context.Variables["rowCount"] + " rows (limit __MAXROWS__) or is larger than __MAXBYTES__ bytes. Ask a narrower question, for example one facility.\"}]}}")
